_meta.description: Semantic registry — declares which sectors measure the same underlying quantity
_meta.status: schema-only — not yet wired into worker
_meta.planned_wiring: Nov 5+ after cron produces fresh data
_meta.consumers: none yet — future PROVENANCE_PAIRS derivation will read this

schema.groups: map of canonical_metric_name → { sectors, direction, tolerance, note }
schema.direction: raw | reciprocal | negate — how to align values before comparison
schema.tolerance: max |r - 1.0| for 'identical' prior; used by PRIORS in worker
schema.sectors: list of sector names that measure canonical_metric_name

us_10y_yield.note: Both report 10-year US Treasury yield. Different endpoints (fiscaldata vs treasury.gov), same underlying metric. 1-day lag observed on one source; r≈0.777 is expected source disagreement, not a bug.

fx_usd_eur.note: Different quote directions. currency-ex reports EUR→USD, exchange-rate reports USD→EUR. Reciprocal normalization required before comparison (already implemented in find_contradictions).

cisa_kev.note: Both count KEV (Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) entries. Likely a subset relationship (count = new per window, total = cumulative) rather than exact identity — r=0.993 observed. Included as provenance but might be better labeled 'related subset'.
cisa_kev.caveat: Confirm whether count is new-per-window vs cumulative; if subset, tolerance should be higher

removed_groups.note: Groups removed Nov 4 2026 due to non-public-domain sources or non-identical semantics
removed_groups.usgs_earthquakes: removed from PROVENANCE_PAIRS — EMSC vs USGS have different magnitude cutoffs, constant −16,500 offset observed. Different catalogs, not same feed.
removed_groups.coinbase_kraken_btc: removed — Coinbase ToS restricts commercial redistribution
